name: PageSetup
description: Contains information about the page setup for slides, notes pages, handouts, and outlines in a presentation.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: FirstSlideNumber
properties.description: Returns or sets the slide number for the first slide in the presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: SlideHeight
properties.description: Returns or sets the slide height, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: SlideWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the slide width, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: SlideSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the slide size for the specified presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: NotesOrientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the on-screen and printed orientation of notes pages, handouts, and outlines for the specified presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: SlideOrientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the on-screen and printed orientation of slides in the specified presentation. Read/write.
